decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan; Design and Access Statement; MLA-BRF-P-011; MLA-BRF-P-012; MLA-BRF-P-013; MLA-BRF-P-014 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-015 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-016 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-017 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-018 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-019 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-020 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-021 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-022 Rev.A; MLA-BRF-P-023 Rev.A. Received 08/03/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
A)	Drawings at 1:5 with details of glazing bars at 1:1 of proposed new windows.

Condition : 4 - A schedule of repair for shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to method used and to colour textile and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by condition attached to this consent.

Condition : 6 - No new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents grilles, security alarms or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved.

Condition : 7 - All existing internal decoration features, including plaster work, ironwork, fireplaces, doors, windows, staircases, staircase balustrade and other woodwork, shall remain undisturbed in their existing position, and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site unless expressly specified in the approved drawings.
Condition : 8 - The existing historic shopfront shall remain undisturbed, and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site unless expressly specified in the approved drawings.

Condition : 9 - The works of demolition hereby approved shall not commence until recording, has been carried out and a contract for procuring the replacement building has been made. Evidence of the same must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority.
description: Internal and external alterations to a listed building.
